name: dom-3s
what: minimize, 3 s, restore with a DOM click of #taskbar-restore

ops.name: titles-0-start
ops.js: (async () => { const d = await window.__app.deskDumpBase64(true); const ls = d.windows.split('\n').filter(Boolean); const keep = ls.filter((l) => /title "[^"]+"/.test(l) && !/title ""/.test(l)).map((l) => l.replace(/ alpha .*class/, ' class').replace(/ style .*$/, '').slice(0, 150)); return JSON.stringify({ n: ls.length, withTitle: keep.length, lines: keep.slice(0, 14) }); })()

ops.name: titles-1-minimized
ops.js: (async () => { const d = await window.__app.deskDumpBase64(true); const ls = d.windows.split('\n').filter(Boolean); const keep = ls.filter((l) => /title "[^"]+"/.test(l) && !/title ""/.test(l)).map((l) => l.replace(/ alpha .*class/, ' class').replace(/ style .*$/, '').slice(0, 150)); return JSON.stringify({ n: ls.length, withTitle: keep.length, lines: keep.slice(0, 14) }); })()

ops.name: tb-1-minimized
ops.js: (async () => { const b = document.getElementById('taskbar-restore'); if (!b) return 'none'; const r = b.getBoundingClientRect(); return JSON.stringify({ hidden: b.hidden, rect: [Math.round(r.x), Math.round(r.y), Math.round(r.width), Math.round(r.height)], active: (document.activeElement && (document.activeElement.id || document.activeElement.tagName)) }); })()

ops.name: restore
ops.js: (async () => { const b = document.getElementById('taskbar-restore'); if (!b || b.hidden) return 'not shown'; b.click(); return 'dom click'; })()
